title: This week in India's growth story.
caption:
This week in India's growth story: 28 stories covering history, sectors and mindset.

1. He went to school in Delhi. Now he runs one of America's biggest phone companies.
2. Indian companies just raised a record $12.5 billion through IPOs. While the stock market was falling.
3. Eleven women in a UP village turned a local gooseberry into a business - and the Prime Minister named them on national radio.
4. He was still working on mathematics at his desk the day he died.
5. She came to Canada from India at age four. In 2026, she was named one of its Top 25 immigrants.
6. She was a homemaker in Odisha who noticed fish farming on a reservoir - and decided to learn the trade herself.
7. He measured a country's progress by what its people could actually do - not just its GDP.
8. India's crude steel output just hit a new high for September. And demand is growing even faster than supply.
9. India's economy just grew faster than the central bank expected. 7.8%, against a 7% forecast.
10. He was born in India. In October 2026, he was elected mayor of a Canadian mountain town.
11. She has walked into roughly 550 villages in a Naxal-affected district most organizations avoided - for almost 40 years.
12. She multiplied two 13-digit numbers in 28 seconds. No calculator, no paper.
13. He was born in Moradabad. Now he runs Apple's entire global operation.
14. India's GST collections just posted their fastest growth of the fiscal year. 25.6% higher than last October.
15. She started with 3 cows and limited market access. A year later, she'd earned Rs 11.5 lakh.
16. A battle near Pune decided the fate of an empire that had ruled for over a century.
17. She grew up in a Telangana village. In September 2026, she became mayor of an Australian city.
18. A Navi Mumbai port just moved more containers in a single month than ever before. Breaking its own record from just one month earlier.
19. Her family's farming barely covered expenses. She switched crops - and her income finally caught up.
20. He led over 2,000 miners and laborers across a border - and got arrested for it. Twice.
21. A Chennai port terminal just set its highest container record in a decade. And broke its own record from the month before.
22. She was born in Mumbai, trained as an engineer. In 2026, she became dean of a top US nursing school.
23. She was confined to her home until a few years ago. Now 400 farmers come to her for advice.
24. He noticed why the sea looks blue - and became the first Asian ever to win a Nobel Prize in science.
25. He was born in a Punjab village. In 2026, he became the first Australian to win horticulture's top global honor.
26. She's trained women in weaving since 1984. In 2026, her handwoven sarees crossed Rs 3 lakh in sales within days.
27. She built India's first tissue culture lab. Then, after retiring, she trained rural women as health workers.
28. India's factories just kept expanding - for yet another month. And export orders just hit a 6-month high.
